acceptanceChecks: A full 500-item queue must preserve existing unsynced actions and reject new distinct actions explicitly, while allowing idempotent updates
Simultaneous organization/community offline saves and remove/save races must not lose previously persisted actions
Storage failure must not permanently block subsequent queue mutations
Automatic reconnect is randomized across 1–7 seconds with one pending timer per device and no duplicate foreground/NetInfo schedule
Automatic sync replays at most eight stored actions from each queue per wave; additional actions remain durable and manual sync stays backwards compatible
Request shield exposes only bounded operation-level counters, with no user IDs, tokens, request bodies or added Supabase telemetry writes
Concurrent same-session requests collapse and are countable, while cross-account reads and successful share-write invalidation remain isolated
No changes to auth, RLS, schema, client runtime, points/reward computation, native packages or EAS release controls
Local Node regression tests, exact-source TypeScript, Engineering Accountability and relevant integration QA must pass before merge
Independent DEV-to-immutable-RC-to-Production-OTA and device checks remain required; no automatic rollout from this PR
